recent_notes.task_title: Implement ralph wrap-up agent on loop exit
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented ralph wrap-up agent on loop exit:

- Added wrap-up.ts module with WrapUpContext, ExitReason types
- buildWrapUpContext() gathers exit state (working tree, tasks, session info)
- buildWrapUpPrompt() generates focused prompt for wrap-up agent
- isWrapUpNeeded() determines if wrap-up should run (dirty tree, error, in-progress tasks)
- runWrapUpAgent() spawns subagent with 2-minute timeout
- Integrated into ralph.ts finally block - runs on all exits except dry-run
- Added session.wrapup event type for audit logging
- Tracks exit reason throughout loop (no_tasks, end_loop_signal, max_iterations, error, max_failures, explicit_tasks_done)

35 tests covering:
- ac-1: Wrap-up spawned on exit (all exit reasons handled)
- ac-2: Working tree inspection (staged, unstaged, untracked reported)
- ac-3: Prompt instructions for commit/stash/flag handling
- ac-4: Exit summary instructions in prompt
- ac-5: 2-minute timeout constant, timeout warning in prompt

recent_notes.task_title: Add --tasks flag to ralph for explicit task scoping
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented --tasks flag for explicit task scoping in ralph:

- Added --tasks <refs> option to ralph run command (comma-separated refs like @task1,@task2)
- parseExplicitTasks() validates refs and resolves to ULIDs
- filterByExplicitTasks() filters session context to only include listed tasks
- allExplicitTasksDone() checks if all explicit tasks are completed/blocked for loop exit
- Updated buildTaskWorkPrompt() to include explicit task scope section in prompt
- Updated dry-run output to show explicit-tasks configuration
- Session start event logs explicitTasks array
- When --tasks is used, automation eligibility is bypassed (can work on manual_only tasks)
- Loop exits when all explicit tasks are completed or blocked

14 tests covering:
- ac-21: Basic flag acceptance, comma-separated refs, ULID/short ULID formats
- Error handling for invalid refs and spec item refs
- Prompt includes explicit scope indicator and updates mode description
- Session event logging
- manual_only tasks included when explicitly specified
- Context filtering to only show explicit tasks
- Loop exit on all tasks completed/blocked

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented observation content search:

- Added --search flag to kspec meta observations command in meta.ts
- Uses grepItem from utils/grep.ts for regex pattern matching (consistent with kspec search behavior)
- Added --observations-only flag to kspec search command
- Added mutual exclusivity validation for scope-only flags (--items-only, --tasks-only, --observations-only)
- 14 tests covering all 7 ACs:
  - ac-search-flag: --search filters observations by pattern
  - ac-regex-support: Pattern treated as regex (e.g., 'friction|success')
  - ac-combined-filters: AND logic with --type and other filters
  - ac-search-all-fields: grepItem searches all text fields
  - ac-search-json: JSON output contains only matching observations
  - ac-global-search-filter: --observations-only limits search to observations
  - ac-only-flags-exclusive: Multiple scope flags produce error

recently_completed.title: Implement ralph wrap-up agent on loop exit
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #369. Implemented ralph wrap-up agent that spawns on loop exit (all exit reasons: no_tasks, end_loop_signal, max_iterations, error, max_failures, explicit_tasks_done). Gathers working tree state (staged/unstaged/untracked), tasks, and session info. Builds focused prompt for subagent to handle cleanup (commit, stash, or flag for review). Runs with 2-minute timeout. All 5 ACs covered by 35 tests.

recently_completed.title: Add --tasks flag to ralph for explicit task scoping
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #368. Implemented --tasks flag for explicit task scoping in ralph: parseExplicitTasks() validates and resolves refs, filterByExplicitTasks() filters session context, allExplicitTasksDone() checks completion for loop exit. Bypasses automation eligibility for explicitly listed tasks. 14 tests covering ac-21 and all edge cases.

recently_completed.title: Implement Observation Content Search
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #367. Implemented observation content search with --search flag for kspec meta observations command and --observations-only flag for kspec search command. Added mutual exclusivity validation for scope-only flags. All 7 ACs covered with 14 tests.

recently_completed.title: Implement Unified Cross-Reference Lookup
recently_completed.closed_reason:
Merged in PR #366. Implemented kspec refs command for unified cross-reference lookup:

- New command file src/cli/commands/refs.ts
- Scans tasks and spec items for all reference fields: spec_ref, depends_on, meta_ref, plan_ref, blocked_by, implements, relates_to, supersedes, traits, tests
- Groups output by relationship type (e.g., 'Tasks (spec_ref)', 'Specs (depends_on)')
- Supports --json flag with structured output
- Uses ReferenceIndex for ULID, slug, and short ULID resolution
- All 12 acceptance criteria covered by 14 tests

recently_completed.title: Implement Module-Scoped Item Listing
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #365. Implemented --under flag for module-scoped item listing. Added findDescendantItems() function to find items by _path prefix within same source file. All 8 acceptance criteria have test coverage in tests/item-list-under.test.ts. Flag works with --tree, --count, --json, and combines with other filters using AND logic.

recently_completed.title: Implement Output Format Option
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #364. Implemented output format shorthands (--json, --yaml, --raw) as global CLI options. Added YAML output support using the yaml library. Conflict detection for multiple format shorthands. 13 tests covering all ACs except ac-unsupported-format (not applicable since --format is not global due to Commander.js limitations with child command option shadowing).

recently_completed.title: Filter superseded notes from default task display
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #363. Implemented note supersession filtering: superseded notes are hidden by default in task get output, added --all flag to show full history, JSON output includes 'superseded' computed field, session start also filters superseded notes. 7 tests added covering all scenarios.

recently_completed.title: Add AC schema field validation to detect drift
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #362. Added AC schema drift detection with checkACSchemaReferences() function that extracts field patterns from AC clauses and validates against SpecItem/Task schemas. Detects conceptual fields (children, parent) and ref strings incorrectly treated as objects. Added --drift flag to validate command. Includes 8 tests covering various drift scenarios.

recently_completed.title: Cache scanTestCoverage() results for daemon performance
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #361. Implemented TTL-based caching for scanTestCoverage() results with 60s expiration. Added coverage-cache.ts module with getCachedTestCoverage() and invalidateTestCoverageCache() functions, per-project caching for multi-directory daemon support, and parallel scan protection. Includes 11 tests covering caching, TTL expiration, invalidation, and multi-project scenarios.

recently_completed.title: Document fenced YAML requirement in plan import help and spec-plan skill
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #360. Added fenced YAML requirement documentation to plan import --help text (new Format section) and spec-plan skill SKILL.md (Important callout). This improves discoverability of the required format for plan files.

inbox_items.text: Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.
E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.
E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.
